svg.title: Lennard–Jones cutoff and magnified tail
svg.desc: A dashed box on the full Lennard–Jones potential identifies separations from 2 to 4 sigma and energies from minus 0.065 to 0.005 epsilon. Dashed connectors link this to the magnified view. At 2.5 sigma a simple cutoff sets the negative tail to zero, producing an energy discontinuity of about 0.0163 epsilon.
